title: AdapterReadGrantResponse
description: DD-89: short-lived source Adapter authorization, not native credentials or proof that the batch finished. The endpoint is resolved from the existing controlled adapter directory.

outcome.description: Native retry observation. COMPLETED requires both immutable receipts and committed usage; UNKNOWN/PENDING carry no renewed authorization.

receiverWrite.description: Separate governed receiver action in the same read Operation. The native importer must perform the existing authenticated PEP check with this token immediately before its write; issuance is not completion.
